extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value that a function approaches as the input approaches some value.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a point if the limit equals the function value there.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The instantaneous rate of change of a function at a given point.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate at which a quantity changes at a specific instant.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and lim g = lim h = L, then lim f = L.

extracted_concepts.name: Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a composite function: [f(g(x))]' = f'(g(x)) · g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Technique to find derivatives of equations not explicitly solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Links differentiation and integration: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of area under a curve using sums of rectangular areas.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exact area under a curve over an interval, defined as the limit of Riemann sums.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: There exists c such that f'(c) = [f(b)-f(a)]/(b-a) on [a,b].

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on a closed interval attains absolute maximum and minimum.

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Evaluates indeterminate limits 0/0 or ∞/∞ by taking ratio of derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to find how one rate of change relates to another over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Infinite sum of terms calculated from function derivatives at a single point.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of terms with constant ratio: S = a₁/(1-r) for |r| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of xⁿ is nxⁿ⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of product fg is f'g + fg'.

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of quotient f/g is (f'g - fg')/g².

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to solve differential equations by isolating variables on each side.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Graphical representation of slopes dy/dx at various points in the plane.

extracted_concepts.name: Newton's Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Iterative algorithm to approximate roots: x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n).

extracted_concepts.name: Linearization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Local linear approximation of a function near a point: L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x-a).

extracted_concepts.name: Arc Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distance along a curve, computed using integrals of derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Coordinates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coordinate system using radius and angle instead of Cartesian x and y.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector-Valued Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function that outputs a vector, typically r(t) = ⟨f(t), g(t)⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Convergence Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Methods to determine whether an infinite series converges or diverges.

extracted_concepts.name: Average Value of a Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mean height of a function over an interval: f_avg = (1/(b-a)) ∫_a^b f(x)dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume of Revolution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Volume generated by rotating a curve around an axis, found via definite integrals.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classifies critical points: f'(c)=0 and f''(c)>0 implies local minimum.
